title: Analog stick (thumbstick) navigation support
description: Wires both analog thumbsticks (GCInputLeftThumbstick, GCInputRightThumbstick) through the same wireDirectionPad helper the D-pad uses (previous piece) - both are the identical GCControllerDirectionPad type in Apple's own API, so every existing D-pad-driven navigation loop picks up stick support for free. Satisfies 'add joystick (wobbly thing) support.' Not yet confirmed with real controller hardware - see notes.md.
commit_message: Wire analog thumbsticks into direction-press pipeline
